target.title: fix(sessions): prevent delivery-mirror prompt contamination with adjacent dedup and identity fallback (#99470)
target.body:
## Summary
- 修复 delivery-mirror assistant 条目泄露到模型 prompt 形成重复消息的问题 (#99470)
- **Layer 1 (身份回退)**: `isTranscriptOnlyOpenClawAssistantMessage` 新增 `openclawDeliveryMirror` 字段检查，捕获 session rebuild/side-branch merge 剥离 provider/model 后的残留条目
- **Layer 2 (相邻去重)**: `normalizeAssistantReplayContent` 折叠与前一条 assistant 内容完全相同的相邻消息（无 tool call 时）
- **P1 修复**: `extractToolCallsFromAssistant` 现在识别原生 Anthropic `tool_use` 块（snake_case），防止 tool-call-bearing turn 被错误折叠
- **未修改**: session 持久化逻辑、gateway 消息广播、用户可见的 transcript 展示

## Real Behavior Proof

Environment: `node --import tsx` (local, no external credentials required)

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/repro/issue-99470-proof.mts

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Case 1 — openclawDeliveryMirror identity fallback
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Stripped mirror entry:
  provider: <undefined>
  model: <undefined>
  openclawDeliveryMirror: { kind: 'channel-final' }
  isTranscriptOnly: true          ← Layer 2 catches stripped-metadata survivor

Normal assistant (no delivery-mirror marker):
  isTranscriptOnly: false         ← real reply correctly survives filter
  ✓ PASS

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Case 2 — Adjacent byte-identical duplicate collapse
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Input: 4 messages (user, assistant, stripped-mirror-duplicate, user)
Output: 3 messages               ← duplicate collapsed, model sees 1 reply
  [0] role=user text="hi"
  [1] role=assistant text="Hello! How can I help?"
  [2] role=user text="thanks"
  ✓ PASS

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Case 3 — Both layers: identity fallback + adjacent dedup
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Input: 6 messages
Output: 3 messages               ← both layers work together in single pass
  [0] role=user text="hi"
  [1] role=assistant text="Hello! How can I help?"
  [2] role=user text="thanks"
  ✓ PASS

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Case 4 — Native tool_use blocks prevent collapse (P1 fix)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Input: 3 messages (user, native-tool_use-turn, text-only-dup)
Output: 3 messages               ← tool_use turn preserved, not collapsed
  [0] role=user blocks=[string]
  [1] role=assistant blocks=[text,tool_use]
  [2] role=assistant blocks=[text]
  ✓ PASS

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Case 5 — Native tool_use in both prev and next prevents collapse
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Input: 3 messages (user, tool_use-turn-a, tool_use-turn-b)
Output: 3 messages               ← both tool_use turns survive
  ✓ PASS

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
5/5 proof cases passed
✓ ALL PROOF CASES PASSED
```

**负控制 (Negative Control)**: 修复前，Case 4 中的 native `tool_use` turn 会被 `isAdjacentAssistantDuplicate` 视为无 tool call 的普通消息，当文本与 delivery-mirror 匹配时会被错误折叠，导致 tool_use 块丢失 → provider 收到 orphan tool_result。

**修复后验证**: Case 4 中 tool_use-bearing turn 完整保留（`blocks=[text,tool_use]`），Case 1-3 中 delivery-mirror 条目被正确过滤/去重，Case 5 确保两个 tool_use turn 都不会被折叠。

## Regression Test Plan
```
$ npx vitest run src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  37 passed (37)

$ npx vitest run src/agents/tool-call-id.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  26 passed (26)

$ npx vitest run src/agents/sessions/session-manager.test.ts --run
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  96 passed (96)

$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/tool-call-id.ts \
    src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.ts \
    src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.test.ts \
    src/shared/transcript-only-openclaw-assistant.ts
→ exit 0
```

## Root Cause

In `extractToolCallsFromAssistant()` (`tool-call-id.ts`), the `TOOL_CALL_TYPES` set
recognizes `"toolCall"`, `"toolUse"`, and `"functionCall"` but not `"tool_use"` —
the native Anthropic API content block type. When `isAdjacentAssistantDuplicate()`
calls `extractToolCallsFromAssistant()` to guard against collapsing tool-call-bearing
turns, native `tool_use` blocks are invisible to the guard. An assistant turn carrying
`{ type: "tool_use", id: "toolu_001", name: "read" }` appears to have zero tool
calls, so if its text content matches a preceding delivery-mirror receipt it is
collapsed as a duplicate. Only camelCase `"toolUse"` blocks had this protection;
`"tool_use"` blocks — emitted by the Anthropic transport stream and handled by
many other codepaths in the codebase — lacked it and could be silently dropped.

AI-assisted: Claude Opus 4.8
